user.title: Set up the speaker
user.description: The model endpoint answers at home; a Helm hub is optional and only takes personal or long requests.

data.extra_headers_json: Extra headers as JSON, e.g. for a priority lane (optional)
data.extra_body_json: Extra body keys as JSON, e.g. thinking switches (optional)
data.timeout_s: Seconds to wait for the model
data.url: Hub address (optional, for escalation and records)
data.hint: Identity hint for a second wake word (optional, not used yet)
data.led_entity: Light entity to colour while unlocked (optional)
data.allow_plain_http: Allow plain http hub: the token is sent unencrypted on my network

init.title: Model profiles
init.description: Edit a profile and switch which one answers. Changes apply immediately.

data.show_profile: Profile to edit and set active
data.model_api_key: Model key (blank keeps the stored one)
data.timeout_s: Seconds to wait for the model

error.plain_http: That hub address is plain http, so the token would cross the network readable. Use https, or tick the box to allow it.
error.model_plain_http: The model address is plain http, so what you say travels unencrypted on my network. Tick the box below if that is intended (a local model endpoint usually is).
error.bad_json: That box must hold a JSON object, like {"X-Header": "now"}.
error.json_too_long: That JSON box is too big.
error.already_configured: This speaker is already set up.

abort.already_configured: This speaker is already set up.
